shows: A picture of the Snowlight map of the contiguous US at night taken at 8:28 AM Central time on October 26, 2026: black land, gray state lines and city names. At this zoom the map draws no school specks. Not in the picture: Snowlight's chance of no school on Monday, October 26 is at most 1% in every one of the 18227 districts with a chance.
